businesses.tagline: Pure Desi Cow A2 Bilona Ghee & Traditional Farm Nutrition
businesses.shortDescription: An esteemed associate company of Sangales Group delivering pure, laboratory-certified Desi Cow A2 Bilona Ghee handcrafted through the ancient wooden bilona method and ethical Ahinsak Dohan.
businesses.about: Anvayi Farms was founded on the sacred principles of purity, cow care, and generational Indian nutrition. Operating in close strategic association with Sangales Group, Anvayi Farms maintains its own indigenous Desi cows raised naturally on nutritious vegetarian farm feed without synthetic hormones or factory confinement. True to the timeless Vedic principle of 'Ahinsak Dohan', the calf is always fed first before any milk is collected. Milk is gently boiled, set into whole curd overnight, and churned clockwise and anti-clockwise with traditional wooden bilona to yield rich cultured makkhan (butter), which is then slow-simmered into pure, golden, danedar (grainy) Desi Cow Ghee. Independently laboratory-tested and confirmed 100% free from preservatives, artificial colors, and adulteration, Anvayi Farms brings heritage health directly to conscious homes across India.

news.title: Sangales Group Announces Comprehensive Digital Infrastructure Launch
news.excerpt: The launch of Sangales.com marks a pivotal milestone in creating a unified corporate presence across all operating companies.
news.content:
SANGALES – A GROUP OF COMPANIES has officially inaugurated its consolidated corporate digital portal, establishing a single authoritative touchpoint for clients, institutional partners, and suppliers worldwide.

Under this unified architecture, each operating business—including Annamrit Foods, Sangales Farms, Sangales Enterprises, Sangales Trading, and Sangales Packaging—maintains distinct operational profiles while benefiting from the group's collective governance, financial resilience, and brand stature.

Speaking on the launch, the leadership emphasized: "Our vision is to build sustainable, deeply rooted Indian enterprises that generate real economic value, create local employment, and foster long-term partnerships. This platform represents our transparent, progressive identity as we look ahead to future expansions in modern technology and distribution."

news.content:
Addressing the imperative need for sustainable alternatives to single-use plastics in the food service sector, Sangales Packaging has introduced an eco-engineered lineup of molded bagasse and unbleached kraft paper meal containers.

The new containers are certified 100% compostable, grease-resistant up to 120°C, and fully microwave-safe, providing restaurants, cloud kitchens, and institutional caterers with an ecologically sound yet structurally robust packaging choice.
news.seoTitle: Sangales Packaging Unveils Compostable Containers | Sangales Group
news.seoDescription: Sangales Packaging launches certified biodegradable, plant-fiber food containers for hospitality and delivery partners.

careers.title: Regional Sales Manager – Food & Institutional Supplies
careers.description: Lead institutional sales and distributor acquisition for Annamrit Foods staples and commercial consumable lines. You will build relationships with supermarket chains, HORECA accounts, and regional stockists.
requirements: 3-6 years of proven B2B or FMCG sales experience in food or institutional products
Demonstrated track record of expanding distributor networks
Strong commercial negotiation and relationship-management skills
Fluency in Hindi, Marathi, and English

careers.title: Operations & Procurement Specialist
careers.description: Coordinate vendor contracting, freight tracking, and quality inspection workflows across agricultural and wholesale industrial merchandise.
requirements: Degree in Logistics, Agribusiness, Commerce, or related domain
2+ years experience in vendor management and bulk procurement
Sound knowledge of inventory software, GST compliance, and freight coordination
High attention to detail and analytical acumen

careers.title: Agricultural Field Agronomist
careers.description: Guide sustainable crop health, IPM protocols, soil testing, and precision drip-fertigation schedules across commercial fruit orchards and farm acreage.
requirements: B.Sc / M.Sc in Agriculture or Horticulture
Field familiarity with drip systems, bio-fertilizers, and seasonal horticulture
Ability to mentor and collaborate with farming crew and rural partners
